title: A table created without a primary key
detail: Without a key a row cannot be addressed, so it cannot be updated, de-duplicated or replicated safely.
fix: Add PRIMARY KEY, on the column or as a table constraint.

fires: CREATE TABLE shop.orders (id BIGSERIAL, channel TEXT);
CREATE TABLE shop.audit (id BIGSERIAL, at TIMESTAMPTZ, actor TEXT);
silent: CREATE TABLE shop.orders (id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, channel TEXT);
CREATE TABLE shop.orders (id BIGSERIAL, PRIMARY KEY (id));
CREATE TABLE shop.orders (id BIGSERIAL, CONSTRAINT pk_orders PRIMARY KEY (id));
CREATE TABLE shop.orders (id BIGSERIAL); ALTER TABLE shop.orders ADD PRIMARY KEY (id);
CREATE TABLE shop.orders (id BIGSERIAL, CONSTRAINT pk_orders PRIMARY KEY (id, channel));
